what: from 01286 (2): hir-ty-mir tests/mir source_names::file_follows_the_names_the_build_gives: file_source_path reports an untracked read when SourceNames does not exist and name_sources does synthetic_write(HIGH); under blaze_query that no longer invalidates the memo. Make the untracked read invalidate as salsa did (or make the read tracked). no-fallback-front-mir then turns location::placed None into an error.

history.note: Already fixed, no edit: source_names::file_follows_the_names_the_build_gives passes in every round since 8 (8, 9, 10, 11b, 12, 14b, 15); it failed through 7c, before the engine fixes. blaze_query marks a run with an untracked read UNTRACKED (function.rs:769), which never verifies (verify.rs:37, function.rs:369) and whose summary is ALL, so synthetic_write(HIGH) after SourceNames is made reruns file_source_path and what read it. no-fallback-front-mir can turn location::placed None into an error.
